description: Literature comparison template for the LectureMind thesis. Papers were independently identified during the literature review. 'reported' values are copied from each paper as published and must not be edited. 'lecturemind_result' stays null until a LectureMind experiment on the stated dataset/protocol exists. Comparability labels: 'directly comparable' (same dataset, task, metric definition and protocol), 'limited/conditional' (same metric definition and a related task, with documented differences), 'not directly comparable'. Never claim superiority across different datasets, tasks, metrics or protocols.

lecturemind_configuration.asr: faster-whisper small (CTranslate2), int8, beam 5, VAD on, condition_on_previous_text off
lecturemind_configuration.retrieval: dense only, per lecture, top-6, cosine threshold 0.6, ~2400-token context
lecturemind_configuration.abstention: threshold before LLM + model answerable flag + citation validation

entries.paper: Cite or Decline: A Strict Course-Grounded Chatbot for STEM Lecture Videos (Ahmed & Subhlok, arXiv:2609.01846, 2026)
entries.dataset: EduVidQA real-world split (269 questions, 99 lectures; corpus 139 videos, 10 courses)
entries.retrieval_method: Dense + BM25 + chapter-summary soft prior, course filter
entries.reason: Only if LectureMind is run on EduVidQA with identical metric definitions; differs in transcripts (platform captions vs LectureMind ASR), embedder, chunking, retrieval budget (7 vs 6). LectureMind Q&A retrieves within one lecture, so only its cross-lecture search matches the course-level setting. EduVidQA access/licence not yet verified.

entries.dataset: VideoPoints production logs (833 messages) + LLM-assisted audit (224 messages)
entries.reason: Different courses, users, question distribution and judge; LLM audit, not human labels. Metric definitions (coverage vs support vs refusal appropriateness) are reused, not the numbers.

entries.paper: Intra-Video Temporal-Aware RAG: A Self-Contained Framework for Video-Based Question Answering (Shafiq et al., CMC 88(2):96, 2026)
entries.dataset: LectQA-Vid (100 CS micro-lectures of 2-5 min, 3000 QA; evaluation on 1000 QA)
entries.modality: Whisper large-v3 transcript + Gemini keyframe captions
entries.retrieval_method: Dense top-K (K=10, threshold 0.60) + temporal-window filter + cross-encoder rerank
entries.reason: Dataset is public; a LectureMind run would be text-only on short videos. Their temporal filter uses a query time window whose inference-time source is not specified; generator and cross-encoder not named; evaluation-split description is internally inconsistent (Section 3.6 vs 5).

entries.paper: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks (Lewis et al., NeurIPS 2020)
entries.dataset: Natural Questions, TriviaQA, WebQuestions, CuratedTrec, MS-MARCO, Jeopardy, FEVER (Wikipedia Dec 2018 index)
entries.embedding_index: BERT-base DPR; FAISS HNSW over 21M 100-word chunks
entries.reason: Open-domain Wikipedia QA with a trained retriever/generator; LectureMind is single-lecture in-context RAG. The paper informs the closed-book vs open-book baseline and k/BM25 ablations, not numeric comparison.

entries.paper: Ragas: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation (Es et al., arXiv:2309.15217)
entries.task: Validating reference-free RAG metrics against human judgments
entries.reason: It validates metrics, not a system. If Ragas-style metrics are used for LectureMind they are secondary signals whose agreement with LectureMind human labels must be measured.

entries.paper: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Radford et al., arXiv:2212.04356)
entries.generator: Whisper small (244M), paper's decoding (beam 5, temperature fallback, VAD heuristics, previous-text conditioning)
entries.reason: Only if LectureMind's exact transcription configuration is run on TED-LIUM3 and scored with Whisper's normalizer. LectureMind uses an int8 CTranslate2 port, VAD and conditioning off, and its own normalizer (lecturemind-wer-normalizer/v1) by default. WER on LectureMind's own lectures is not comparable to these numbers.

entries.paper: Speech Retrieval-Augmented Generation without Automatic Speech Recognition (Min et al., ICASSP 2025)
entries.dataset: SpokenSQuAD (TTS, ~60 s passages), VoxPopuli English (~10 s)
entries.task: Text-query to speech-passage retrieval and QA
entries.embedding_index: E5-Mistral-7B embedding space; index not reported
entries.reason: Different data (TTS and parliamentary speech), one relevant passage per query, LLM-generated queries, ASR-free modality. It motivates a WER-to-retrieval sensitivity study in LectureMind, not a numeric comparison.

entries.paper: VideoRAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Extreme Long-Context Videos (Ren et al., arXiv:2502.01549)
entries.retrieval_method: Knowledge-graph text retrieval + ImageBind visual retrieval + LLM filtering
entries.reason: Relative LLM judgments without ground-truth answers, multi-video and multimodal setting.
